inclusions.text: Private felucca, never shared with other guests
inclusions.source: The felucca is hired privately for your party — never shared with other guests — and the sail takes bookings from a single person upward, with no minimum group.
An English-speaking assistant and one bottle of mineral water per person are included; a lunch (onboard or riverside) is an optional add-on, chosen at booking.

inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person

inclusions.text: Pick-up from agreed meeting point and short transfer to the Aswan Corniche
inclusions.source: The experience begins with a pick-up from your agreed meeting point and a short transfer to the Aswan Corniche — the broad riverside promenade that runs along the east bank of the Nile.

inclusions.text: Soft drinks and mineral water (Nile Feast lunch package)
inclusions.source: Soft drinks and mineral water are included.
